meta.title: 离职选月中还是月末？社保断缴差几千块
meta.title_en: When to Quit: Mid-Month or Month-End? Social Security Pitfalls

scenes.title_en: The Cost of a Bad Resignation Date
scenes.context: 讲者指出离职时间选不好会损失几千块，并用粉丝真实案例说明。
sentences: 离职选在月中还是月末，大有讲究。
Whether you quit in the middle or at the end of the month makes a big difference.
大有讲究：makes a big difference
选的时间不光是少拿几千块，甚至要倒贴一两千。
Bad timing doesn't just cost you a few thousand—you may even have to pay money out of pocket.
倒贴：pay out of pocket
原公司没有给交社保，补缴也被拒绝，只能自己掏了一千五。
The old company didn't pay his social security, refused to make it up, and he ended up paying 1,500 himself.
补缴：make up the payment
paraphrase: 离职日 = 财务决策 → 不是随手选
Your resignation date is a financial decision, not an afterthought.
案例教训 → 补缴没那么容易
The lesson: getting back payments isn't that easy.
scenes.speak: Whether you quit in the middle or at the end of the month makes a big difference. Bad timing doesn't just cost you a few thousand—you may even have to pay money out of pocket. The old company didn't pay his social security, refused to make it up, and he ended up paying 1,500 himself.

scenes.context: 讲者给出对策核心：先弄清公司社保缴纳时间线，多为当月 15 号或 20 号。
sentences: 离职之前，一定要先了解清楚公司缴纳社保的时间。
Before resigning, make sure you understand when your company pays social security.
缴纳社保的时间：when the company pays social security
一般公司会以当月的15号或者20号为时间线。
Most companies use the 15th or 20th of the month as the cut-off point.
时间线：cut-off point
选择15号之后离职，当月社保原公司会给你交。
If you resign after the 15th, your old company will still cover your social security for that month.
当月社保：that month's social security
paraphrase: 时间线 = 当月社保归属的分界
The cut-off is the line that decides who covers your insurance that month.
15 号后离职 → 当月社保稳
Resigning after the 15th keeps your coverage safe.
scenes.speak: Before resigning, make sure you understand when your company pays social security. Most companies use the 15th or 20th of the month as the cut-off point. If you resign after the 15th, your old company will still cover your social security for that month.

scenes.title_en: The Domino Effect of a Coverage Gap
scenes.context: 讲者说明 15 号前离职且新公司晚入职会导致断缴，断缴影响福利与资格申请。
sentences: 如果你在15号之前离职，一时半会又没找到新工作，当月社保就会断缴。
If you quit before the 15th and haven't started a new job yet, you'll have a coverage gap that month.
断缴：coverage gap
社保连续性与当地的福利政策、资格申请紧密相关。
Social security continuity is closely tied to local benefits and eligibility for applications.
资格申请：eligibility for applications
一断缴，这个影响还是蛮大的。
A gap in coverage can have a big impact.
影响蛮大：can have a big impact
paraphrase: 衔接断档 → 资格与福利受损
A gap in coverage damages your benefits and eligibility.
社保是连续账 → 排期要算
Social security is a continuity game—plan your dates.
scenes.speak: If you quit before the 15th and haven't started a new job yet, you'll have a coverage gap that month. Social security continuity is closely tied to local benefits and eligibility for applications. A gap in coverage can have a big impact.

practice: When you resign makes a big difference for your benefits.
If I resign after the 15th, my social security for that month is covered.
I'll have a coverage gap if I don't line up the next job in time.
A social security gap can affect my eligibility for local benefits.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：The old company doesn't pay the social security for me.
✓ 地道说法：The old company didn't cover my social security that month.
cover 比 pay for 更贴切「缴纳社保」场景。
✕ 直译腔：I must compensate the payment.
✓ 地道说法：They refused to make up the payment.
make up the payment 是「补缴」的地道说法。
✕ 直译腔：The social security is broken.
✓ 地道说法：I'll have a coverage gap.
断缴对应 coverage gap，不是 broken。
✕ 直译腔：The influence is very big.
✓ 地道说法：It can have a big impact.
影响大用 impact 更自然。
shifts: 离职日期当成财务决策来排期
以为社保断了随时能补
补缴可能被拒，提前规划衔接
社保连续性与资格申请一起算进离职成本
footer_notes: ASR 校正：原文「员工司」按语境校正为「原公司」，「掌纳」校正为「缴纳」，「工资金」校正为「公积金」。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
